summary: AISDLC-707 / #2508: clear the plain queue manifest wedged beside an iterate-needed verdict so reenter can run a review round on head 9fbadb85

options.description: Dispatch moves queue/AISDLC-707.dispatch.json to retired/AISDLC-707.dispatch.json adding retiredAt and retiredReason='stale plain manifest beside iterate-needed verdict (DEC-0395)', then runs cli-dispatch reenter 2508 with the review-round note (head 9fbadb85; Step 11 pushes head and verdict together). Recommended: keeps the iterate-needed record, mirrors dequeue's output, one file, reversible by moving it back.

remove-verdict, dequeue, then a fresh plain enqueue of AISDLC-707. Loses the iterate-needed record and the review-round note; the plain manifest is a new task under the open-PR cap and stays held at 3 of 3.
Leave #2508 parked until AISDLC-1228 lands and the reconciler reenter succeeds on its own. No manual board write; #2508 waits for a task that itself needs a cap slot.

body: 2026-11-07: done/AISDLC-707.verdict.json (iterate-needed, 08:12Z) and queue/AISDLC-707.dispatch.json (plain, dispatchedAt 04:53Z, requeued by the AISDLC-1217 pane-exit path) coexist. reenter refuses 'already in queue/', dequeue refuses 'has a verdict in done/', and remove-verdict would make reenter refuse 'not in done/'. The reconciler reenter failed x2 on the unchanged head (AISDLC-1125). No CLI path exists; the guard fix is AISDLC-1228 (PR #2513). This record authorizes ONE manual board move for this task only. Class (a): an operational repair that loosens no control; the retired/ record keeps what dequeue would have written.
